name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v3446: GitHub reports a TIMED-OUT job as cancelled, not failure, so when the 25-minute ceiling fires the gate set does not go red — IT GOES SILENT, and a missing verdict reads like a scheduling hiccup. #123 quoted a stale gate count for weeks for exactly that reason, and the suite has already crossed once at 25.3m. A verdict job now runs on always() and fails loudly when no verdict was produced. Measured: the gate set is 95 percent of the job wall clock, so sharding is the only real lever and is deliberately NOT done here. 8 red-proofs; the CI-side behaviour is honestly marked UNVERIFIED-until-CI because nobody has watched a real timeout fire. Plus the shadow-log reducer: 6,082 Claude-vs-Grok rows that nothing had ever read, 67.6 percent disagreeing on names while that lane is primary — published with both lanes and their reach, never preferring one. 9 red-proofs.
